reasons: Claimed status is compliant; the cited paragraphs support it — p0200 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively preserves each party's right to enter similar agreements, and no cited text restricts Customer's ability to operate businesses, buy or build competing products.

The only Customer-side prohibitions cited (no resale of the Services in p0190; license-scope limits in p0202) govern use/redistribution of IBM's own Services and IP, not competitive activity, so they fall outside the NONCOMPETE rule's scope.
No redline or comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
Rationale is accurate and non-overreaching, correctly noting that a territory limit on IBM's delivery is a vendor-side restriction and therefore acceptable.
